name: Oberweis chocolates
about: A local chocolate shop in Luxembourg City known for handmade pralines and truffles. Its chocolates are made by a Luxembourg confectioner, so they are a true city treat.
tip: The soft pralines do not keep well, so eat them soon or keep them cool and away from heat.

name: Luxembourg Moselle crémant
about: A sparkling wine made in the Moselle valley, where Luxembourg's vineyards sit along the river. It is a good local alternative to Champagne.
tip: Check the label for 'Crémant de Luxembourg AOP' to make sure it is the local wine, not the French crémant.
